messages:
ana_sales: quick ask 1  Hybrid reseller 'CloudHarbor' wants an unusual reseller credit structure to close a cross-region POC with a public sector client. tagging @ben_partnerships @carmen_dealdesk for approvals

ben_partnerships: summary pls - what's different from standard APAC/EU rate cards?

ana_sales: they want a 25% channel discount to the *end customer* for a 120-day POC, + a 10% reseller admin credit on top of the channel margin (effectively increasing their take). Standard is 18% channel in the region. They also asked for a pre-POC security questionnaire checklist and a temporary higher commission rate for the first 6 months.

carmen_dealdesk: that's multi-dimension. Need PSD (partner sales design) and finance delta. Also ask them why the admin credit is needed and whether they can invoice MDF instead.

ana_sales: partner says customer requires price parity with incumbent and supporting reseller add-on helps them manage local tax/invoicing. They offered to sign a 6-month exclusivity window for that account if we grant the credits. CRM opp id RDW-CLH-9900.

raj_finance: high level: extra credit + higher commission compresses gross margin and raises churn risk. We need a quick net revenue simulation and to know if exclusivity triggers any revenue recognition constraints. Also confirm if credit is refundable (clawback) if commit not met.

henry_ps: POC PS load ~80 hours across infra + integration. If credits go to partner instead of MDF, we'll need a PS voucher to cover our engineering time. Also we must require standard security checklist (SOC2 summary + DPA) before any env access.

ben_partnerships: I'm willing to consider a time-limited credit if: 1) partner signs a binding commit (min $150k ARR in 9 months) 2) the admin credit is structured as a recoverable credit (clawback) if commit isn't met, 3) exclusivity limited to named customer only, 4) security docs + DPA in place.

carmen_dealdesk: opening DD-10111 to track this. please upload CRM opp, quick margin calc, proposed exclusivity language, and SOW. Link: https://redwood.company/dealdesk/DD-10111 :memo:

ops-bot: DD-10111 created 2 status: Open  awaiting finance + legal review.

ana_sales: quick inline calc for reviewers:

```
POC list price: $120,000
Requested end-customer discount: 25% -> customer pays $90,000
Partner channel margin (std 18%): $16,200
Requested admin credit (10% of net): $9,000
If elevated commission (25% for 6mo) apply on net: +$22,500
Net to Redwood on POC approx: $90,000 - 22,500 - 9,000 = $58,500
Baseline (18% no admin credit): customer pays $120,000 - partner 21,600 = $98,400 -> net delta on POC ~ -$39,900
```

raj_finance: that delta is material. We need RevOps to model ARR scenarios and propose whether to require upfront partial payment or hold MDF against escrow.

henry_ps: also add SLA expectations in SOW. No reduced uptime for public sector customers.

ben_partnerships: next steps: 1) get partner to sign a draft addendum with commit + clawback + one-customer exclusivity 2) legal to review DPA/security checklist 3) finance + RevOps to sign off on margin model and cashflow terms (escrow/prepay vs monthly) 4) deal-desk DD-10111 to close. If all green, approve a 120-day time-limited credit with structured clawback.

carmen_dealdesk: I'll add checklist to DD-10111 and request RevOps model. Please drop final CRM docs by EOD.

ana_sales: will upload SOW + partner addendum and ask partner about prepay. Thanks all :pray:
